turns.tutor: Hi! Tip: the main idea comes from the whole text, not only the first sentence. Read this email: "Dear Yasmin, Thank you for your nice letter. I have some news! Our family is moving to a new flat next month. The flat is on the fourth floor, and it has a big balcony. My new school is near the river, but my old school was next to the mosque. The moving day is on 14 May. My father starts his new job on 20 May. Can you visit us in June? We have a small room for guests now. Write soon! Love, Huda" What is it mostly about? (a) thanks for a letter (b) the family is moving (c) a room for guests
